title: Remove All Adjacent Duplicates in String II
summary: Given a string s and an integer k, repeatedly remove k adjacent and identical characters until no such removals are possible, then return the modified string.
statement: Given a string s and an integer k, repeatedly remove k adjacent and identical characters until no such removals are possible, then return the modified string.
constraints: Repeated removals may expose new adjacent groups.
hints: A stack run stores one character and its current adjacent count.
Increment the top run for a match, otherwise push a new run.
Pop immediately when a run reaches k; later characters can then merge with the newly exposed top.
The stack always represents the fully reduced processed prefix.
editorial: The stack always represents the fully reduced processed prefix.

tests.explanation: No adjacent character appears twice, so the string is unchanged.
Removing eee, ccc, bbb, and then ddd leaves aa.
